text:
Jon (PM): quick a11y review request for the new bulk model upload modal. Pilot users reported confusion with keyboard and screen reader during uploads. can someone do a sweep?

Priya (Design): saw this in staging. two major things: 1) when you drop files, focus stays on the file input, not the upload list so keyboard users miss the list. 2) the small grey "remove" link under filenames is 11px and low contrast.

Sam (Eng): thanks, repro'd locally. Also noticed the progress rows are rendered as divs with progress bars but no aria attributes. NVDA doesn't announce percent or completion.

Nadia (Accessibility): yep, missing `role=\"progressbar\"` + `aria-valuenow/min/max` is the main SR gap. Also keyboard order jumps: after a file completes the DOM reorder moves focus unpredictably. We should avoid DOM reorders while an element has focus.

deploy-bot: axe report: 4 violations found on /models/upload 
- color-contrast on `.file-meta--remove` (WCAG AA fail)
- aria-allowed-attr on `.file-row` (aria-* on nonwidget)
- programmatic focus change without announcement (focus moved during upload completion)
- progressbar missing/value (aria-valuenow not present)

Priya (Design): proposed small spec:
- strong remove link: make it 13px semibold, color #111827 on #FFFFFF or invert w/outline,
- visible focus ring for file rows (2px brand 5B21B6) when keyboard nav is active,
- maintain visual order but use `aria-live=\"polite\"` region for status updates rather than DOM move.

Sam (Eng): engineering options:
1) keep DOM stable: append completed files to the bottom visually but don't remove or reorder nodes until user navigates away,
2) add `role=progressbar` + `aria-valuenow` on the bar element, update value with each chunk,
3) when we do need to move focus programmatically, call `announce()` to SR via a polite live region,
4) toolbar remove link -> convert to native button (not link) so `aria-pressed` not relevant but keyboard semantics are correct.

Nadia (Accessibility): also consider keyboard affordance for drag-to-reorder. Right now rows are draggable with mouse only. If reordering is a required feature, add move-up/move-down buttons with `aria-label` and keyboard handlers; if not required, hide drag handle from SR and keyboard.

Jon (PM): timeline? pilot next Tue so we need a small patch this week. Can we scope to low-risk fixes?

Priya (Design): low-risk = contrast on remove, focus ring + stable DOM + progressbar attributes. draggable keyboard handler can be follow-up. I'll put exact color/token values in Figma tonight.

Sam (Eng): I'll implement:
- convert remove link to `<button class=\"file-remove\">`
- add `role=\"progressbar\" aria-valuemin=\"0\" aria-valuemax=\"100\" aria-valuenow=\"xx\"` on each bar and update during upload,
- avoid reordering nodes while an element has focus, instead set `aria-live=\"polite\"` on a status region to announce completion,
- add focus-visible styles for rows.

deploy-bot: branch create: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4890` linked to UX-2180. Automated tests scheduled.

Nadia (Accessibility): test checklist for QA:
- NVDA/VoiceOver: drop 3 files, tab into file list, confirm focus ring lands on first row, use keyboard to activate remove button, confirm SR announces removal, watch progress announcements from live region, confirm percent updates are read as they change, verify no focus jump on completion.
- Axe: run against staging after patch.

Sam (Eng): implemented aria attrs + button conversion. One oddity: screen reader reads percent for each update which is noisy. We can debounce updates (announce every 10%) or set `aria-live` on the container only for milestones.

Priya (Design): prefer debounced updates at 10% increments — less noise for long uploads. add visual micro-animations for percent changes so sighted users get feedback too.

Nadia (Accessibility): agreed on 10% milestone announcements. Also add `aria-label` like "Upload progress: 30 percent" for clarity.

Sam (Eng): pushed fix and flagged debounce + aria-label. PR: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4890` ready for review.

deploy-bot: axe re-run on PR: issues fixed except contrast on a tertiary small-caption in footer (deferred).

Jon (PM): good. file follow-up ticket UX-2181 for drag keyboard affordance.

Priya (Design): I'll update Figma and add a small note in the upload component spec about stable DOM and debounced SR updates.

Nadia (Accessibility): will join QA smoke tomorrow. if we pass NVDA/VO checks, mark ready for pilot.

Sam (Eng): thanks team, will merge behind feature flag and ship to staging.

Jon (PM): thanks everyone :thumbsup: — linking the pilot docs after smoke: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-2180

Nadia (Accessibility): final note: file-row headings were duplicated for sighted caption + sr-only label; prefer single visible heading with `aria-hidden` on the decorative caption to avoid double readouts. small change but will remove noise.

Priya (Design): noted and updating spec.

Jon (PM): perfect, closing this thread once PR is merged.
